verdict.rationale: Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas is a law firm that provides legal advisory services, not a software product, so reading its source code under an open license is a category error for this kind of offering. Its legaltech pages describe adopting AI tools in its practice and running a startup incubator, not shipping software of its own.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
